title: Skalary Review Limit Vocabulary
description: Plan c21cdc D3/D17. The single owner of every shared limit and leaf type the review-plan, review-run, review-manifest and terminal-status schemas apply. Each of those schemas embeds the definitions it needs verbatim under its own `$defs` and refers to them with internal `#/$defs/...` pointers only: an external `$ref` would make one schema file unusable on its own, and step 2.1 distributes these files individually into consumer installs. `test:ReviewReport.SchemaCapabilityAndSemantics` proves every embedded copy is deep-equal to the definition here, so the duplication cannot drift. Numeric budgets no structural keyword can express (UTF-8 byte counts, rendered view sizes) live in `x-skalary-limits` for the semantic layer to read.

x-skalary-layers.structural: Everything expressible as a draft-2020-12 keyword: closed objects, discriminators, enumerations, patterns, cardinality and per-string maxLength (counted by the validator in UTF-16 code units).
x-skalary-layers.semantic: Everything a single-document schema cannot decide: unique task ids, unique concern/model slots, exact frozen-plan equality, findings tied to a completed task, UTF-8 byte budgets, rendered view budgets and manifest digest verification.
